base: satsuma-core-2.2.37-duzeltilmis archive of 2026-11-18 (no git history, docs and release/ folder in the archive)
source_tests: 2334 passed, 24 skipped, 13 failed + 4 collection errors on an Ubuntu 24.04 container (Python 3.13). Every failure but one needs PyQt5/PyQt6, which the container lacks; the other is satsuma-core-windows, which still imports the retired satsuma.ram.engine (Windows RAM-ClamAV removal not done).
rpm_build_note: rpmbuild is not available where this source was prepared; build on Fedora with: SATSUMA_RPM_BUILD_ROOT=$(mktemp -d) bash packaging/build.sh
publisher_signature: unavailable; package built locally and not signed
behavior_changes: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.63.md: DoH server names blocked and Firefox canary NXDOMAIN; OTX never auto-blocks update servers (fedoraproject.org, flathub, snapcraft); hot-added DNS names applied via systemctl reload; children of Satsuma's own ExecStop/ExecStartPre processes recognised; restart cap removed (shared ledger with backoff, SATSUMA-HEALTH-RESTART-001); satsuma-admin hidepid. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.62.md: module allowlist (only modules this computer loaded may load; learned at the module lock, enforced next boot; bluetooth and bridge/stp/llc/tun stay loadable), carried into the initramfs with rpm-ostree initramfs-etc; module lock at 2 minutes; fwupd msr/i2c boot loads voided; open-vm-tools masked; strict mode 73 stops + conditional module rules, upgrade exception removed; signed policy (Ed25519, key sealed with the admin password, satsuma-admin politika); kill/block only through privd for teams/core/sentinel (SATSUMA_PRIVD_ONLY); NoNewPrivileges on 7 units; satsuma-reader own user; field self-test satsuma-admin oz-test and hourly privd probe. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.61.md: strictest mode (satsuma.strict_mode, on by default): 62 report-only rules now stop; 48 stay reports because they match the OS or the owner; GAP-036/037/052/075 stop in this mode (an upgrade with --install satsuma-core-*.rpm stays an alarm); satsuma-admin en-siki-mod (off needs the admin password). Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.60.md: privd.request socket settings renamed (socket_path, socket_timeout); remediation's path= was taken for the socket and every file quarantine failed with Connection refused since 2.2.56; critical SATSUMA-PRIVD-001 finding when an undo cannot reach privd. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.59.md: DeepSeek rule guard (satsuma.ai_guard: linear regex in a child process, breadth corpus, own 20 ms budget after bundled rules, suspension after 3 strikes, protected targets, interactive admin tools and trusted JIT report only, 5 stops/10 min then 1 h report only, max 100 active, satsuma-admin deepseek-kural); stream events confirmed by the kernel in privd (AI process rules could never stop); deep-engine cron rule takes writes only. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.58.md: rpm-ostree package/deployment changes need the admin password (/usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d/10-satsuma-package-auth.rules); polkit rule writes caught and undone (GAP-074); removing Satsuma/security packages or rolling back raises an alarm (GAP-075, alarm-only); 306 rules. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.57.md: Satsuma's own short service runs recognised from systemd's ExecMainPID record (packaged units only; dns-refresh was judged as GAP-047); packaged python -m satsuma.* units count as own code; one stop per process; PRIV-003 ignores Satsuma's exact desktop-enrollment command. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.56.md: automatic remediation of one-shot attacks (firewall restored at once, persistence files quarantined, new/UID 0 accounts locked, wheel additions undone; privd 'remediate'; protected files and accounts never touched); fake kernel threads (GAP-072); module load from file or forced (GAP-073); kernel.io_uring_disabled=2; SELinux switched to permissive at run time is put back; kernel guard restores become findings (304 rules). Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.55.md: independent Atomic Red Team benchmark (tools/atomic_benchmark.py; 423 Linux tests: 2.2.53 63, 2.2.54 100, 2.2.55 156 stopped; techniques 35/52/72 of 117); 21 more coverage_gaps rules (302 total), GAP-052 alarm-only. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.54.md: 50 coverage_gaps rules (281 total; corpus 101/109 stopped, 2 alarm-only); high/critical report-only rules recorded as trace_only (never stop); audit watches home persistence/key entries, /var/roothome, /var/spool/cron, /var/usrlocal, backlog 8192, loginuid-immutable; Atomic path aliases in file rules; regex budget in CPU time; clamonacc virusgroup + SELinux antivirus_can_scan_system; PrivateUsers drop-ins for 6 services; PPP /bin/true; coredump ordering cycle removed; benign boot messages filtered; health checks for on-access and ostree cleanup. Earlier: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.38.md: account-file writes judged by what they changed; account guard covers empty/DES has
